kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Upper band Rs 94 (54,26,400 fresh + 6,03,600 OFS shares, Rs 56.68 cr). At Rs 94: market cap Rs 189.4 cr post-issue; P/E 17.27x on FY26 PAT (12.62x on pre-issue shares; 9.35x on the company's weighted EPS of Rs 10.05); P/B 2.10x post-issue; EV/EBITDA 9.8x. Objects floor Rs 63.

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: Operating cash flow negative three years running: Rs -5.74 cr (FY25) and Rs -11.46 cr (FY26) against PAT Rs 4.56 / 10.97 cr. Trade payables fell from Rs 21.40 cr to Rs 1.68 cr and inventory rose Rs 8.88 cr in FY26; capex Rs 26.91 cr; funded by Rs 47.16 cr of financing (borrowings Rs 13.32 cr -> Rs 46.82 cr and the loan conversion).

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: Rs 15.87 cr FY26 loan from promoter entity Sethsawaria Poly Fab LLP converted into equity; trackers report the related-party ratio fell in FY26. Terms of conversion not read.

focus.detail: West Bengal 96.8% of FY26 revenue; one plant (Barasat); trackers flag sharply higher counterparty concentration. Lamination 59% of FY26 revenue; billet-strip trading on a bill-to-ship basis is part of revenue.

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported P/E is a fair measure: the adjustments found move FY26 PAT by +0.0%, within the 10% threshold. On the FY24-FY26 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 35.1x reported and 35.1x adjusted.
checked: PAT growth (FY25 Rs 4.56 cr -> FY26 Rs 10.97 cr) ahead of revenue growth (+41%) is explained by the shift from trading to manufacturing (trackers); not tested against the notes
Capitalised costs, cash tax, exceptional items and related-party pricing could not be tested without the RHP
Profit is not yet cash: operating cash flow negative in FY25 and FY26
